title: Warri Gad of deebisanii Dhugaa Barbaadan
intro: Biyya aangoo durii fi falfalaa keessatti waldhabdeen guddaan ni uuma. Gama tokkoon aangoo mallattoo waaqaa kan fayyadamu yoo ta’u, gama biraan immoo waan hin danda’amne walsimsiisuuf yaala. Bu'aan isaas bara baraan adeemsa seenaa ni jijjiira. Eenyummaa warra dhugaa isa dhumaa arganii isa duratti of gad of deebisan saaxiluu dandeessaa?
clues: Mallattoolee mala falfalaa irra darbee mul’atan argineerra
Hundi keenya dhugaa ganuu dadhabnee sujuuda keessatti kufne
Mallattoowwan kun Waaqa Tokkicha Dhugaa irraa akka dhufan hubanneerra
Hawaasa jalqabaa karaa diraamaa akkasiitiin amantii fudhate nuti
Amantii keenyaaf jannata akka nuuf ta'u waadaan nuuf galfame
Funyoon fi uleen keenya ija keenya duratti bofa ta’an, ta’us garuu bitamuu filanne

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
